_honesty_note: TRUTH-UP 2026-08-08 (S2·Lane V). This record previously described a Sentinel-2 L2A NBR crop at fixtures/vision/sentinel2-burn-area-crop-001.png — an image that was never on disk, so `imageRef` named nothing and only MockVision (which reads no pixels) could 'use' it. It now points at a REAL recorded tile. The recorded pixels are NASA GIBS MODIS Terra bands 7-2-1, not Sentinel-2: keyless Sentinel-2 coverage (GIBS HLS_S30) was probed for this bbox and returned empty/partial swaths, and Copernicus Sentinel-2 needs credentials the demo must not depend on (plan §0 decision 11). The FILE NAME is retained because two suites outside this lane import it by path (application/interaction/command-router.test.ts, main/build-vision.test.ts); renaming it to gibs-burn-area-001.json is queued for S3, when those files can be touched.
